_comment: Known drift per frame/case: the harness fails when a case gets worse than this (plus slack: 2.0% pixels, 1.0 px bounds, 0.5 px font). Regenerate with -PvitroParityUpdateBaseline=true; keep or write each "reason". An update records regressions too: read the diff before committing it, and keep the entries of cases with an open regression. #794 empties this file.

mirror/clock-date.reason: the date line and layout match HA (its start cut off at the large size, as HA's marquee rests); what is left is glyph antialiasing on the 64 px digits and 24 px date, just over the 2% line

mirror/entity.reason: value, unit and icon match; the card is ~18 px shorter (HA's entity card keeps more bottom padding under the value) (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/entity-filter.reason: the wrapped entities card loses its title ("Lights off") and header toggle, and rows show the bare entity name ("Window") where HA prefixes the device ("LED Strip Window"); card ~50 px shorter (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/gauge.reason: arc thinner and ~15% smaller, its track lighter grey than HA's near-black, the 74% value smaller and drawn on canvas (missing text), card ~27 px shorter (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/gauge-needle.reason: needle and severity bands ignored: Vitro draws one green value arc with no red/yellow segments and no needle; same smaller arc, value and ~27 px shorter card as the plain gauge (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/layout-card.reason: the 2x2 grid of tiles is laid out, but its column gap and margins differ: Vitro's tiles start ~10 px higher and right of HA's and the card is ~24 px off (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/markdown-cardmod.reason: harness limit: Robolectric's Skia draws Inter's default instance and ignores its wght/opsz axes, so the 56 px weight-300 h1 renders regular and its line box differs (Humidity 2 px higher, card ~2.5 px off). On the panels Inter's axes apply: the Vitro Glass clock's light digits draw like HA's on the tablet and the S1 (2026-11-24)

mirror/markdown-cardmod-has.reason: the sheet applies as in HA (:host centering, ha-card:has() tint, green heading, 18 px bold paragraph). Left: Vitro sizes Markdown runs in whole device px (AbsoluteSizeSpan), so the 16.38 px h3 draws at 16.5-16.67 (fractional sizes tried 2026-11-24: font deltas 0 but no pixel gain, markdown-table worse); the 18 px line sits 0.85-1.35 px lower and the card 0.3-0.5 px taller; Android's Roboto against the frontend's web Roboto. The report's +4.5 px on "text." is not Vitro: HA's run box starts at the space before it

mirror/media-control.reason: at 1.5x HA's border is 1.5 px and Vitro's 1 px (every card's), so the blue inside is 2 device px wider (748 vs 746) and each white icon and the name sit half a pixel off; the diff is their edges and the border line, 2.3% on this small high-contrast card. The layout, colors and sizes match (the tablet case matches; 2026-11-24)

mirror/mushroom-title.reason: title 16 vs 24 px and subtitle 13 vs 16 px, with less top padding: the text sits ~25 px higher than HA's (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)

mirror/picture-elements.reason: image and positions match; the state icon sits on a dark disc and the state label on a dark pill that HA doesn't draw, label 12 vs 14 px (coverage #794, 2026-11-24)
